_comment: THE SPEC — the single source of truth every renderer reads. Web (src/spec.js) mirrors this file exactly and tests/test_spec_parity.py fails the build when the two drift; a future C#/WPF or Qt renderer reads THIS file, never the JS. Only cross-stack facts live here: colours, face order, timing, which rings and emblems exist, the sun/moon rules. Web-only recipes (CSS gradient strings, SVG path data) stay in src/ — they cannot be honoured by a stack that has no CSS.

axes._comment: The house axis language, shared with Gadgets/3D Preview (shared/spec.json) and Gadgets/DOMY Watch (SYMBOLISM.md). Colour names are POSITIONAL — the palette decides the hue, never the meaning.

sequence._comment: Owner decree 2026-08-07. The order each face takes the TOP, and it is the colour wheel: yellow, orange, red, purple, blue, green. By position: top, right, back, bottom, left, front. Every consecutive pair shares a cube edge, so every transition is one 90-degree tumble and no step is a double flip — tests/test_face_order.py proves it rather than trusting it. It is also, face for face, the order of the six arms on the DOMY Watch dial.

finishes._comment: Names only — the recipes are per-stack (src/textures.js for the web). A stack that cannot draw one must say so, never silently substitute another.

emblems._comment: Owner decision 2026-08-07: `elements` is the DEFAULT. The moon sits on amethyst and water on sapphire, and that is not a clash with the DOMY canon but the same idea read one layer down — blue IS water and the moon is what pulls it, while purple is the night the moon hangs in. `elementsDomy` keeps the strict reading (moon on sapphire) for anyone who wants the dial's letter.

rings._comment: One ring per face, and the ring shown is the one belonging to the face currently on TOP. These are compositions, not icons repeated round a circle (owner 2026-08-07: 'ne bezveze slicice listova nego napredni vizuelno lepi'). `radius` is a multiple of the cube's edge, measured from the cube centre — the owner's sketches put the ring well clear of the cube, never hugging it.

sky._comment: The sun and the moon are real bodies riding a circle around the cube, not merely a light direction (owner 2026-08-07). Upper half of the circle is the sun's, lower half the moon's: 06:00 left, 12:00 at the zenith, 18:00 right, 00:00 at the bottom. A full moon really does light the cube — from below, so it is the lower faces that catch it — and its strength follows the phase.

defaults._comment: What a consumer gets when it passes nothing. ONLY the spinning colour cube is core; everything else is opt-in (owner 2026-08-07).
